title: 按住 Ctrl 選字時仍能完成自動複製
summary: 修正持續按住 Ctrl 時，重複按鍵事件取消自動複製與動作列的問題。
highlights: 同一次 Ctrl 按住操作不再重複取消選取；重新按鍵、點擊及切換視窗的保護仍保留。
放鍵等待延長為兩秒，容許選完文字後自然地放開 Ctrl。
usage: 更新後沿用原設定；在完成選取時按住 Ctrl，再放開即可觸發自動複製。

en.title: Keep auto-copy working while holding Ctrl
en.summary: Repeated Ctrl-down events no longer cancel a pending auto-copy or its action bar.
highlights: One held Ctrl gesture no longer repeatedly cancels selection; fresh key presses, clicks and window changes still invalidate pending work.
A two-second release window allows a natural pause before releasing Ctrl.
en.usage: Existing settings are preserved. Hold Ctrl when finishing selection, then release it to trigger auto-copy.
